For Claude 4.6 and later models, specifying US-only inference through the inference_geo parameter incurs a 1.1x multiplier on all token pricing categories, including input tokens, output tokens, cache writes, and cache reads. On Claude Haiku 5.5, the multiplier also applies to the higher prices for …
Models earlier than Claude 4.6 don’t support the inference_geo parameter and always use standard pricing. On these models, a request that includes the parameter returns a 400 error.
Fast mode pricing applies across the full context window, including requests over 200k input tokens.

Claude 4.6 and later models (except Claude Haiku 5.5) and Claude Mythos Preview include the full 1M token context window at standard pricing. (A 900k-token request is billed at the same per-token rate as a 9k-token request.) Prompt caching and batch processing discounts apply at standard rates acros…

Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays higher prices. A request’s prompt length counts all of its input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes. Each request is priced on its own: a request over the threshold pays the higher prices even…
Execution time has a minimum of 5 minutes.
Each organization receives 1,550 free hours of usage per month.
Additional usage beyond 1,550 hours is billed at $0.05 USD per hour, per container.

On the Claude API, web search costs $10 USD per 1,000 searches, plus standard token costs for search-generated content. Search results count as input tokens, both while Claude keeps searching within a turn and in later conversation turns.
